newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar follows New York lower.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar follows New York lower.

text.p: LIFFE sugar contracts fell aping New York's follow-through weakness from Wednesday's losses, traders said.
"It's two different markets, but they are doing much the same thing at the moment," one said.
But there was some underlying support in London, which explained how front month August had managed to creep up from its low on producer buy-backs, he said.
By 1515 GMT August was $1.80 lower at $308.60 compared to a low of $308.30. Volume on August was 872 of a total 1,071 lots.
In New York there was a sharp down move in early trading as the market followed through from Wednesday's downturn.
